settings.raw_html:
Studio

Lisbon studio, remote team

How do you work remotely?

Our 24 people work across Europe from a Lisbon home base. Every project gets a shared board, weekly reviews and one senior lead you reach directly.

Can you work across our time zones?

Yes, clients in 12 countries so far. We plan reviews around the hours we share and keep the work moving async in between.

Can we meet the team in person?

Yes. Kick-offs often happen at our Lisbon studio, and for bigger launches we come to you. Pico, our studio dog, handles the welcome.
